image_description: A close-up profile portrait of a guenon monkey, specifically showing the head and upper shoulders. The subject has olive-green and grey fur with a distinctive white throat ruff. The face is bare-skinned with pinkish tones around the muzzle and nose. The eye is forward-facing with a brown iris. The background is a soft, out-of-focus dark green/brown bokeh.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the bare facial skin and the fur. AI generators often struggle with this boundary, creating a 'melted' or overly smooth transition. Also, inspect the eye for realistic depth and catchlight; flat or plastic-looking eyes are a common failure mode in animal portraits.
